heading.title: Of the Produce and Interest of Legacies

article.title: Interest on sum to be invested produce annuity.
article.content: Where a sum of money is directed to be invested to produce an annuity, interest is payable on it from the death of the testator.
article.html:
355Interest on sum to be invested produce annuity.

Section 355 · Part IX · Chapter XI · page 89 of the Act

Where a sum of money is directed to be invested to produce an annuity, interest is payable on it from the death of the testator.
